==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the Day)
:'''Yago:''' *Sleeping sounds*
:{{DIcon}} Hey, wake up.
:'''Yago:''' Ahh! I'm not slacking off!
:'''Yago:''' Phew... Thank goodness. You're not Mr. Sebastian.
:'''Yago:''' Oh, I was just... you know, setting the mood! Keeping things relaxed, as is befitting the family's reputation!
----
;(at Night)
:'''Yago:''' How should I prune these flowers?
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:'''Yago:''' As you can see, I'm tending to these Violacas.
:'''Yago:''' Trying to fend off the drowsiness from these flowers while cutting them into perfect squares? Truly, a labor of love...
:{{DIcon}} But... the petals are still curved.
:{{DIcon}} You don't even have pruning shears.
:'''Yago:''' Oh no, please! Please don't tell Mr. Sebastian!
{{Dialogue End}}
